name: Vintage Tulip Diamond Ring
subtitle: 1 CT Antique-Cut Oval Lab Diamond · 10K or 14K Gold
summary: An antique-cut oval lab-grown diamond held by eight eagle-claw prongs above a tulip-inspired petal basket, with a slim polished gold band.
description:
Vintage-inspired faceting meets a sculptural tulip setting. A 1.00 ct antique-cut oval lab-grown diamond is held by eight eagle-claw prongs, with petal-like gold details beneath the centre.

The plain, polished 1.8 mm band keeps the focus on the stone and its floral basket. Choose solid 10K or 14K gold in yellow or white. Antique-cut describes the diamond’s vintage-style faceting.

10K gold: $1,495 CAD. 14K gold: $1,750 CAD. Both gold colours are available at the same price for the selected purity.
